definitions.explanation: Lacking sensitivity to subtle cues, feelings, or changes. Can describe being unaware of others' emotions or not picking up on social signals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鈍感|どんかん}⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}づかない→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: He's insensitive, so he doesn't notice her feelings.
There are people who are insensitive to pain.

examples.japanese: ⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{鈍感|どんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ほう→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。⟦{気|き}にし→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧⟦すぎ→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: You should be a little more thick-skinned. You worry too much.

notes:
USAGE:
Used to describe someone who doesn't pick up on subtle cues, whether emotional, social, or physical.
- {鈍感|どんかん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (an insensitive person)
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鈍感|どんかん} (oblivious to the atmosphere)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鈍感|どんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become insensitive)
- {鈍感|どんかん}{力|りょく} (the power of being thick-skinned - a positive spin)

NOTE ON {鈍感|どんかん}{力|りょく}:
This term gained popularity from a 2007 bestselling book by {渡辺|わたなべ}{淳一|じゅんいち}. It presents being {鈍感|どんかん} positively as a survival skill—not overthinking or being overly sensitive to criticism.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鈍感|どんかん} ↔ ⟦{敏感|びんかん}→敏感：06641_binkan⟧ (insensitive ↔ sensitive)
- {鈍感|どんかん} ↔ ⟦{繊細|せんさい}→繊細：07607_sensai⟧ (dull ↔ delicate/sensitive)
